reviewer: Codex via fully opened official faculty catalogue and 2026/27 doctoral admissions

units.name: Faculty of Mechanical and Industrial Engineering
units.evidence: The official English university faculties inventory and faculty page use the exact Industrial Engineering faculty title. The faculty page describes production and management engineering research, but by itself does not establish a named Industrial Engineering doctoral award.

sources.note: Full official faculty list includes Faculty of Mechanical and Industrial Engineering, Faculty of Management and Faculty of Mathematics and Information Science.
Full official faculty page names exact faculty and its broad research areas; production/management engineering is scope, not a doctoral title.
Full current winter 2026/27 Doctoral School intake and discipline limits show active doctoral provision; no exact eligible discipline title.

limitations: The faculty's Polish site uses Wydział Mechaniczny Technologiczny; historical/current naming relationship needs a dated university source before treating that string as a settled alias.
The Faculty of Management and mathematical/technical doctoral field inventories remain to inspect; reported 2005 individual degree is discovery only.
